notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2): a valid zip container without manifest.blobs also holds the zero-data entry blobs, which carries the DOS directory attribute (0x10) and whose name does not end with '/'. Only the final '/' makes a directory entry (§11.9 rule 4), so blobs is a zero-byte root file the layout does not list (the blobs/ directory is not a file, §11.1): E_CONTAINER_ENTRY at entry enumeration (narrow review medium-1 N1). The Rust verifier called the entry a directory entry and accepted this zip before the fix.
